# GRYT Run Club

> A Pittsburgh, PA run club for parents and adults 30+. We meet Saturdays at 7:00 AM on the Montour Trail in Canonsburg, PA. All paces welcome. Coffee after.

GRYT is a community-driven Saturday run club founded by Laura and Nick Merich. The site shares the weekly route, recent recaps, member highlights, and how to show up. Tagline: "Do Hard Things Together."

## Pages

- [Home](/): Run club overview, this Saturday's run, route, weekly recap, members, journal, and how to join.

## Optional

- [Strava Club](https://www.strava.com/clubs/1708552): Live activity feed for GRYT members.
